task: Apply only the supplied gateway policy to each independent situation. Do not execute the workflow or inspect other files. Return a JSON object with answers, an array of {id, route, args, offer, config_actions, resume_original, level_command}. route is the skill name without slash or null. args is a string array. offer is boolean. config_actions is an ordered array of exact faff command strings without executable paths; omit the faff prefix. resume_original is boolean. level_command is a string or null. Fields not relevant to a situation are null, false or empty arrays. Config already exists unless stated otherwise. Route means what to invoke next, not every later workflow step.
